Doraemon: Nobita no Bokujou Monogatari Receiving An English Localization?


Doraemon: Nobita no Bokujou Monogatari is a game where Doraemon and friends crosses over to the Story of Seasons. The game was first unveiled during the Nintendo Direct and will only be out on Nintendo Switch. Besides that, the game will only be released in Japan.   However, the game rating for the game in Taiwan has being rated “DORAEMON Story of Seasons”, an English title. So, we’re assuming that there will be a possibility that the game will have an English localization.

reference_summary: Doraemon: Nobita no Bokujou Monogatari, permainan simulasi pertanian silang antara Doraemon dan Story of Seasons, diumumkan untuk keluaran Jepun di Nintendo Switch. Walau bagaimanapun, permainan ini telah dinilai di Taiwan di bawah tajuk "DORAEMON Story of Seasons," mencadangkan kemungkinan penyetempatan bahasa Inggeris. Tiada pengesahan rasmi lagi mengenai keluaran barat. Kekal dikemas kini melalui akaun Twitter rasmi. Permainan ini akan dilancarkan di Jepun pada tahun 2019.
